activation.title: Activate DZBuild POS
activation.intro: This PC needs a DZBuild POS licence: a 7-day trial or a lifetime licence. Send this PC's code to DZBuild, then paste the key you receive.
activation.scan: Scan it with your phone to send it by WhatsApp.
activation.scanCode: Scan it with your phone to copy the code.
activation.demoHint: No licence and no fiscal value: to discover the software.

device.label: This PC's code
device.qr: QR code of this PC's code

form.keyHint: It starts with DZL1. Paste all of it, even over several lines.

state.expired: This PC's trial has ended. Activate a lifetime licence to sell again.
state.otherDevice: The licence found belongs to another PC ({{code}}): this PC changed (disk, Windows or processor). Send the new code below.
state.tampered: This PC's licence data was changed. Paste your key again to activate it again.
state.refused: This PC's licence is no longer accepted. Contact DZBuild for a new key.
state.deviceUnreadable: Windows does not give this PC's identity. Restart it; if it continues, contact DZBuild support.

banner.readOnly: Read-only mode: sales and changes are blocked. Reports, exports and backups stay available.

till.title: Till in read-only mode
till.body: This PC cannot sell without a valid licence. Reports, exports and backups stay available in the menu.
till.ask: Ask the owner to activate this PC's licence.

settings.title: This PC's licence
settings.removeBody: This PC will be read-only: no more sales or changes. The key stays valid and can be activated again.
settings.removed: Licence removed: this PC is read-only.
